opening.speaker: A
opening.text: Bet you three dollars you can't get a paper ball in the trash from behind the couch.

answers.speaker: A
answers.text: It has to stay in. Bouncing out doesn't count.

answers.speaker: B
answers.text: Best of three, I'm not doing this in one.

edge_cases.question: Does it count if it bounces in and out?
edge_cases.answer: No. It has to stay in the can.
